Package io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.generator

Class BaseCommandGenerator

java.lang.Object
io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.generator.BaseCommandGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandGenerator
Direct Known Subclasses:
BukkitCommandGenerator, PaperCommandGenerator, StandaloneCommandGenerator
public abstract class BaseCommandGenerator extends Object implements CommandGenerator
Base generator shared by every platform.

A platform only supplies its entry points and platform types; routing, parameter resolution and suggestions live here. The generator reads CommandModels only and never parses annotations, so a new platform does not need to know how the parser works.

To add a platform, extend this class, implement generateEntryMethods(com.palantir.javapoet.TypeSpec.Builder, io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.model.CommandModel), getWrapperClassSuffix(), getSenderTypeName(), and getManagerType(), then return it from CommandGeneratorFactory.create(javax.annotation.processing.ProcessingEnvironment).
